title: ValuePilot: A Two-Phase Framework for Value-Driven Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how well an AI decision-making model captures and adapts to individual subjective biases across six human value dimensions (Curiosity, Energy, Safety, Happiness, Intimacy, and Fairness) by comparing the model's ranked action selections against human-subject decisions using an Order-Sensitive Similarity (OS-Sim) metric.

Implementing a two-stage quality assurance protocol (automated self-filtering and human review) to measure and eliminate preconceived biases, irrelevant value mentions, and spurious correlations in LLM-generated training scenarios and actions.
